Name: Tree with Birds
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[b][color=#ff00ff][size=5][center]On sunny days, birds will visit the trees and bring the Fairy Roses.
On rainy days...?[/center][/size][/color][/b]
[size=2]The tiles to be constructed are 1x1 squares, so they do not take up much space.
They can be used for farm layouts.

The birds are animated.

[/size]Construction is locked at the start of the game.
The conditions for unlocking... [spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Robin's friendship level is 3 hearts or more.[/size][/color]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Buses to the desert are in service.[/size][/color]
[/list]If you fulfill these two conditions, you will receive an mail from Robin.
Read it and it will appear in Robin's construction menu.
[/spoiler]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=6]Notes.[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Version 1.5~ All functions are now working properly![/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=3]There are several changes and notes associated with it.
If you are updating from an older version, please open the “spoiler” tab below to review the contents![/size][/color][spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5]If you are updating from version 1.5 or earlier, delete the old file![/size][/color]
[/list]Overwriting and updating may cause unexpected problems.

[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]A feature that has been restored in version 1.5.[/size][/color]
[/list][list=1]
[*]You can now click on a tree to receive an item.
[*]Mod behavior can now be changed from the ModConfig settings.
[/list]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Specification changes in version 1.5.[/size][/color]
[/list][list=1]
[*]The number of Fairy Roses you receive is now randomized if you talk to the birds during the time they are staying in the trees. (Previously, it was fixed with one.)
[*]The quality of the Fairy Rose that you get when a bird is staying in the “?????” tree of the Fairy Rose is now random.
[*]The items you get when you talk to the frogs during the time they are there on rainy days are now randomized. (Previously, it was fixed for each day of the week.)
[*]“Iridium Bar” has been added to the list of items you can get when the frogs are there on a rainy day.
[*]The cost of building a tree in the “?????” tree has been changed from 10,000 g to 50,000 g.
[*]ModConfig setting changes are now applied correctly in-game (when actually controlling the character).
[*]Birds and frogs are no longer displayed in the architectural menu.
[*]If multiple trees of the same type were built, it is no longer possible to receive items from each. All trees of the same type are now managed under the same flag, so if you receive an item from one tree, you will not receive items from the others. (You can still receive items from other types of trees.)

[/list]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff][size=3]Fixing bugs and glitches.[/size][/color]
[/list]Fixed a problem that caused flickering in the bird and frog displays.
Fixed a problem with “Wallpaper” being one of the items given by frogs on rainy days.
Fixed a problem that sometimes caused birds to be displayed on GreenRain days.

[list]
[*]A few minor notes.
[/list]If you received an email from Robin in the old version, you will still receive the same email in the new version.
This is not a particular problem and you do not need to worry about it.
 [/spoiler]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Notes.[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]If you perform an action on a tree for the first time that day while there is no room in your inventory, a message will be displayed but no item will be available.[/size]


Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.
